description: A driver wants a usable summary of which students need seating accommodations, behavior reminders, sensory considerations, or extra supervision so the ride stays safe without relying on memory alone. All schools are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 46-year-old veteran driver who knows the route well but wants student-specific support notes kept current
user_profile.context: Small support details matter on the bus, but they are easy to forget when several students have distinct needs
user_profile.communication_style: Practical and student-centered, wants concise notes tied to concrete rider needs

fact_sheet.fact: Liam Chen (Student ID: 45821) requires seating in seat 3A, the window seat directly behind the driver, for all trips.
Ava Garcia (Student ID: 51233) uses a custom booster seat with a five-point harness, which must be secured in seat 2B.
Sophia Rodriguez (Student ID: 59374) responds positively to a verbal reminder: 'Sophia, we use quiet voices on the bus.'
Liam Chen (Student ID: 45821) is sensitive to loud, sudden noises; he wears blue noise-canceling headphones during the ride.
Mason Miller (Student ID: 60198) must be the last student to exit the bus at Northwood Elementary to ensure a safe handoff to school staff member Ms. Gable.
The morning pickup for Bus Route #14 'The Bluebird Route' begins at 7:05 AM at the corner of Juniper Ave & 12th St.
All student-specific support notes are updated bi-weekly in the 'RiderNotes' tablet application, with the last sync on October 23, 2023.
Mason Miller (Student ID: 60198) has a severe peanut allergy; his EpiPen is located in the red pouch on his backpack strap.
If Noah Patel (Student ID: 62045) becomes agitated, offering him his designated fidget spinner often helps him self-regulate.
Bus #14 is equipped with a Zonar V4 telematics system for GPS tracking and route management.
A visual confirmation (thumbs-up) is required from Liam Chen's father, Mr. Chen, before pulling away from the morning stop at 845 Oak Street.
Sophia Rodriguez (Student ID: 59374) is sensitive to strong smells; the use of air fresheners is prohibited on Bus #14.
The primary contact for the Transportation Department is Ms. Evelyn Reed, reachable at 555-0125 during operational hours (6:00 AM - 5:00 PM).
Noah Patel (Student ID: 62045) must have an empty seat next to him (seat 5B) to prevent physical crowding.
A 2-minute verbal warning before arriving at her stop helps Sophia Rodriguez (Student ID: 59374) prepare for the transition off the bus.
The total mileage for one complete round-trip of Route #14 is 28.7 miles.
The fire extinguisher on Bus #14 is located under the driver's seat and its next inspection date is December 1, 2023.
Driver David Carter must mark 'present' for each of the 18 students on the 'RiderNotes' app during both morning and afternoon boarding.
Ava Garcia (Student ID: 51233) has asthma; her emergency inhaler is in the side mesh pocket of her purple backpack.
Non-urgent incident reports for Route #14 must be submitted via the 'SafeRide' online portal by 6:00 PM on the day of the incident.
The bus radio volume should be kept at or below level 8 to accommodate students with auditory sensitivity.
Praising Mason Miller (Student ID: 60198) for 'safe hands and feet' reinforces positive bus behavior.
The afternoon drop-off for Route #14 concludes at 4:15 PM at 1920 Maple Drive.
At the end of the afternoon route, a full bus walk-through is mandatory to check for sleeping children or forgotten items.
Bus #14's on-board security camera system records to a 256GB solid-state drive that retains footage for 7 days.
For a medical emergency, after calling 911, the second call is to Northwood Elementary's school nurse, Jennifer Kim, at 555-0199.
Siblings Sophia and Leo Rodriguez must sit together in seats 4A and 4B.
The code word for a potential external threat requiring radio silence is 'Bluebird is nesting'.
Ava Garcia (Student ID: 51233) prefers the window on her right to be closed to reduce wind noise.
